options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: comment
options.description: Additional information about this GRE tunnel

options.name: id
options.description: Unique identifier of the static IP address that is associated to a GRE tunnel

options.name: internal_ip_range
options.description: The start of the internal IP address in /29 CIDR range.

options.name: ip_unnumbered
options.description: This is required to support the automated SD-WAN provisioning of GRE tunnels, when set to true gre_tun_ip and gre_tun_id are set to null

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: primary_dest_vip
options.description: The primary destination data center virtual IP address (VIP) for the GRE tunnel. Defines where the primary GRE tunnel should terminate.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: secondary_dest_vip
options.description: The secondary destination data center virtual IP address (VIP) for the GRE tunnel. Acts as a backup GRE tunnel destination in case the primary VIP is unavailable.

options.name: source_ip
options.description: The source IP address of the GRE tunnel. This is typically a static IP address in the organization or SD-WAN. This IP address must be provisioned within the Zscaler service using the /staticIP endpoint.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: sub_cloud
options.description: Restrict the data center virtual IP addresses (VIPs) only to those part of the subcloud

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.

options.name: within_country
options.description: Restrict the data center virtual IP addresses (VIPs) only to those within the same country as the source IP address.
